name: Storyboard & Video
description: Plans an idea (plus optional character/object/background/style references) into a 20-60 s multi-scene storyboard with a locked style bible, makes one consistent keyframe per scene, animates each with Kling/Seedance (keyframe bridging or in-clip multi-shot) and joins the clips with ffmpeg, with native audio or ElevenLabs music/voice-over and burned captions; publishes to YouTube, Instagram or TikTok.

execution.service_target: engines/story_engine.py (storyboard-video planner + models, run inside Palette-Video)

invocation.note: No broker service; async steps with SSE /events/{project_id}. The chain is driven by the app's own browser UI (engine.ts).

extra_capabilities: ElevenLabs narration + music with ducking and burned captions
best_for: 20-60 s multi-scene story or ad videos from an idea
recurring characters/products/locations kept consistent from references
narrated shorts with voice-over, music and captions
9:16 shorts ready for YouTube, Instagram or TikTok
AI-filmed product animation and exploded views (parts separating in mid-air, real footage, not a diagram)
realistic explainers and ads with AI footage plus labels, arrows, measurements and creator/explainer effects added on top by the engine
not_good_for: videos under 20 s or over 60 s
profile_notes: From source v0.0.0757 (read 2026-11-13). Planned total 20-60 s (2-20 scenes, 3-10 s each). Joins clips with hard cuts. Never renders logos or readable text. Runs as an engine inside Palette-Video (the app's own planner prompt and models, vendored); its own screens are not used. Exploded views and product animation added 2026-11-13 as AI footage (unverified). 2026-11-13: the engine adds graphics (Motion Studio overlay) and effects (Effects Studio) itself when they help.
